question.prompt: Rachelle uses \(3\) pounds of meat to make \(8\) hamburgers for her family. How many pounds of meat does she need to make \(24\) hamburgers for a neighborhood picnic?

solutions.explanation:
The \(24\) hamburgers make \(24\div8=3\) batches of \(8\). Each batch needs \(3\) pounds of meat, so Rachelle needs
\[
3\times3=\boxed{9}\text{ pounds},
\]
choice \(\boxed{\text{E}}\).
solutions.title: Scale the number of batches
